name: search-proxy-invalid-api-key
description: The proxy refuses a call whose API key is unknown, disabled, expired or malformed with a 401 problem document that says retryable false, so the client raises it with no retry, and sends the call again only when the key lookup gives another key: AuthenticationError, the class of its status, with its code, invalid_api_key, and its trace id.

origin.edit: The website proxy's own 401 invalid_api_key problem document, retryable false, answers the search.

call.question: ODA disbursements from Germany to Congo in 2018

input.query: ODA disbursements from Germany to Congo in 2018

json.title: Unauthorized
json.detail: The API key is not valid. Check the key, or leave it off to call without one.
